## Description

Comprehensive testing of dropdown menus, select lists (standard and JQuery-based), list box components, filtering mechanisms, and date picker widgets (both bootstrap and JQuery).

## Pages Covered

| #   | Page Name              | URL Path                  |
| --- | ---------------------- | ------------------------- |
| 1   | Select Dropdown List   | `/select-dropdown-list`   |
| 2   | JQuery Select dropdown | `/jquery-select-dropdown` |
| 3   | Bootstrap List Box     | `/bootstrap-list-box`     |
| 4   | JQuery List Box        | `/jquery-list-box`        |
| 5   | Data List Filter       | `/data-list-filter`       |
| 6   | Bootstrap Date Picker  | `/bootstrap-date-picker`  |
| 7   | JQuery Date Picker     | `/jquery-date-picker`     |

## What to Handle

- Standard HTML dropdown selection
- JQuery-enhanced dropdown interactions
- List box single and multi-select
- Dynamic list filtering and search
- Bootstrap date picker widget
- JQuery date picker calendar navigation
- Option/value selection and verification
- Dropdown state changes (enable/disable, visibility)

## Acceptance Criteria

- ✅ All 7 pages accessible and elements respond to selection
- ✅ Dropdown selection and deselection working
- ✅ List box single and multi-select modes verified
- ✅ Filter/search functionality updates list correctly
- ✅ Date picker opens, navigates months/years, and selects dates
- ✅ Bootstrap and JQuery date pickers behave consistently
- ✅ Selected values properly reflect in the UI
- ✅ All tests use `setup('<page name>')` fixture
- ✅ Page objects created for dropdown/select interactions
- ✅ Assertions separate in dedicated files

## Out of Scope

- Keyboard-only navigation (Tab, arrow keys) — covered in forms card if needed
- Browser-specific rendering
- Timezone handling for date pickers
- Locale-specific date formatting beyond defaults
- Performance with large datasets
